post.title: How house flippers make money (and what the $66K hides)
post.ig:
ATTOM says the typical 2025 house flip made $65,981 in gross profit, before repairs.
The median flip was bought for $259,019 and resold for $325,000 in 2025: a 25.5% gross return, ATTOM's lowest since 2008 (down from 32.1% in 2024).
Gross profit is resale minus purchase only: it excludes renovation, loan interest, property taxes and other costs, and the average 2025 flip took 163 days to resell.
The typical gross margin was 21.5% in Q2 2026.
Sources: ATTOM Year-End 2025 and Q2 2026 Home Flipping Reports; HousingWire; MPA Mag.
